verdict.rationale: Khoj is a personal AI assistant, so cross-session memory is a fair axis. However, the evidence only documents retrieval over files and notes the user shares and syncs (desktop app, Obsidian, Notion, GitHub). That is user-supplied document indexing, an adjacent feature, not durable memory the assistant writes to and recalls automatically. Nothing in the pack describes Khoj saving facts about the user or recalling past conversations across sessions.
